export async function fillCheckoutForm(
  page: Page,
  input: CheckoutParams
) {
  // Locator with auto-retry self heal
  const form = page.getByTestId('checkout-card-form');
  await form.waitFor({ state: 'visible' });

  await page.fill('#cc-name', input.cardholderName);
  await page.fill('#cc-number', input.cardNumber);
  
  // Handles nested Stripe iframe
  const frame = page.frameLocator('#stripe-frame');
  await frame.locator('#cvc').fill('123');
  
  await page.click('button[type="submit"]');
}
